Canada reaches World Cup knockout stage with historic win

Canada has achieved a historic milestone by securing their first-ever knockout stage win in the FIFA World Cup, defeating South Africa 1-0. The decisive goal came in stoppage time from Stephen Eustaquio. This victory propels Canada into the Round of 16, where they will face a yet-to-be-determined opponent.
